override.reason: On the final holdout (12 Sep - 4 Dec 2011) the frozen selection, HistGradientBoosting, had mean WAPE 24.6% against 9.5% for seasonal naive, a bias rising to +33% at 8 weeks, a negative forecast for the week of 26 Dec 2011 and 80% ranges covering 0-44% of weeks. The validation window (Feb-Jun 2011) contained no peak season. Seasonal naive is adopted as the operational default for the business total; this choice was made after seeing those holdout results.

total.evaluation_note: Chosen after reviewing holdout results: the holdout figures for this model are not an independent evaluation of the decision, and no untouched data remains to provide one.
total.interval_note: Nominal 80% range from this model's own calibration residuals (n = 5-12 per horizon); measured holdout coverage 58%-71%. The ranges are too narrow to be read as reliable 80% ranges. This coverage is not independent of the override decision.

products.interval_note: Nominal 80% range from this model's own calibration residuals (n = 100-240 per horizon); measured holdout coverage 57%-80%.
